events.title: Domitian is murdered and Nerva becomes emperor
events.description: Emperor Domitian was stabbed to death in a palace conspiracy, and the Senate chose the elderly Nerva to succeed him. Nerva's adoption of Trajan began the era of the 'Five Good Emperors'.
events.html: Emperor Domitian was stabbed to death in a palace conspiracy, and the Senate chose the elderly Nerva to succeed him. Nerva's adoption of Trajan began the era of the 'Five Good Emperors'.

events.title: Constantine defeats Licinius at Chrysopolis
events.description: Constantine's victory over his co-emperor Licinius at Chrysopolis, across the Bosporus from Byzantium, made him sole ruler of the Roman Empire. He soon refounded Byzantium as Constantinople.
events.html: Constantine's victory over his co-emperor Licinius at Chrysopolis, across the Bosporus from Byzantium, made him sole ruler of the Roman Empire. He soon refounded Byzantium as Constantinople.

events.title: A Byzantine-Georgian army fights the Seljuks at Kapetron
events.description: A Byzantine-Georgian army met a Seljuk raid into Byzantine-ruled Armenia, led by Ibrahim Inal, half-brother of Sultan Tughril I, at Kapetron. In the night battle Byzantine forces won on the flanks, but their Georgian allies were defeated in the centre.

events.title: Philip Augustus becomes king of France at fifteen
events.description: Philip II, the fifteen-year-old only son of King Louis VII, began his reign as king of France. Later called Augustus for enlarging the crown lands, he won Normandy, Anjou, Maine and Poitou from King John of England from 1204.
events.html: Philip II, the fifteen-year-old only son of King Louis VII, began his reign as king of France. Later called Augustus for enlarging the crown lands, he won Normandy, Anjou, Maine and Poitou from King John of England from 1204.

events.title: The Teutonic Knights defeat the Polish army at Chojnice
events.description: Near the town of Chojnice, the Teutonic Knights defeated a Polish army in the first year of the Thirteen Years' War. The war had begun when the Prussian estates rebelled against the Order and placed themselves under King Casimir IV Jagiellon.

events.title: George Washington lays the cornerstone of the US Capitol
events.description: President Washington laid the cornerstone of the Capitol in a Masonic ceremony. Congress first met in the unfinished building in November 1800.
events.html: President Washington laid the cornerstone of the Capitol in a Masonic ceremony. Congress first met in the unfinished building in November 1800.

events.title: President Fillmore signs the Fugitive Slave Act
events.description: Part of the Compromise of 1850, the act required citizens of free states to help return people who had escaped slavery, and denied them a jury trial. It turned many Northerners against slavery.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix dies in London aged 27
events.description: Guitarist Jimi Hendrix died in London after taking barbiturates. In four years of fame he had transformed the electric guitar with his use of feedback, distortion and virtuoso technique.
